svg.title: FTF-01 #68 — 함께 지키는 오늘, 더 푸른 내일의 바다
svg.desc: Four-panel polished cinematic manga scene: six-month reef monitoring shows 35% coral-cover growth, divers verify a healthier reef, juvenile fish return to the coral nursery, and the ocean guardians renew their promise at sunset. Korean, Chinese and English captions and visual effects.
